description.text: Core courses Higher Mathematics, University Physics, Engineering Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, etc.), Engineering Mechanics, Engineering Cartography and Computer Graphics, Safety System Engineering, Safety Human-Machinery Engineering, Principle of Safety, Safety Management, Civil Engineering Safety, Management of Dangerous Sources of Electro-mechanics, Safety Evaluation and Technology of Safety Monitoring. Objective This objective is to train students to be comprehensive, interdisciplinary, high-quality engineering and managerial specialized personnel, who will be able to work in the fields of Safe Technology, Design of Security System, Safety Management, Safety Supervision and Control, Safety Training, Safety Evaluation, Safety Economy and Safety Information, all the fields being related with civil engineering construction, electro-mechanics and dangerous chemical products. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering is granted.

duration.text: The Safety Engineering at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
